newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: PARLIAMENT VOTES TO COMPENSATE LOSSES.
newsitem.headline: PARLIAMENT VOTES TO COMPENSATE LOSSES.

text.p: The Lithuanian parliament decided on Tuesday to recognise the debts of budget financed organisations and the fourth quarter 1996 losses of Lithuanian Energy as part of the country's internal debt.

The debts of budget financed institutions included those for heating and electricity costs and subsidies for pharmaceutical products as of January 1, 1997, the parliament's protocol department said in a statement.
The law said that the amount of debt shall be established by the country's energy resources and control commission.
The law also said that the state's debt shall be paid from the 1997 and 1998 budgets.
Sixty-eight members of parliament voted in favour of the law, four voted against and four abstained.
